profile.overview: Orzhov Syndicate is the white-black Ravnican guild where religious legitimacy, deals, debt, business, and cartel hierarchy overlap.
profile.philosophy: Power becomes durable when obligation can be recorded, collected, and made institutionally legitimate.
profile.core_tension: Orzhov presents religious and institutional authority while the reviewed guide emphasizes deals, business, debt, organized crime, and cartel leadership as its operating reality.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guide presents Orzhov as a religious organization whose modern identity is deal-making business, a loose affiliation of cartels led by priests or kingpins.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Afterlife is Orzhov mechanics texture; death, tokens, sacrifice, lifegain, drain, recursion, or extort do not prove Orzhov identity without source-bounded obligation and institution context.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

native_fit_commanders.why_this_fits: Teysa is the clearest native Orzhov product fit: she doubles death-trigger value and turns token bodies into a more threatening spiritual workforce.
native_fit_commanders.skip_if: Skip if you dislike sacrifice loops, death-trigger stacks, or incremental value engines.
native_fit_commanders.gameplay_summary: A death-trigger amplifier that rewards aristocrats shells, afterlife-style tokens, and creature-based value trades.
